summary: Frontend-only e2e verification of 5 new SoD Command Center add-ons on /app/sod (Recap Preview, Voice Intro, AI Thread Titles, Open Map sparkline, Digest Branding + public share page). All wired, integrated with backend, and persisting. No uncaught runtime errors; only pre-existing Radix DialogContent aria-describedby cosmetic warnings (ignorable per request).
verified_flows: Login admin + /app/sod loads with no pageerror / no 'X is not defined'

Recap Preview: recap-preview-btn opens recap-preview-dialog with recap-preview-item-0 populated (e.g. 'What are the top risks in this digest right now? 2×'). Backend GET /api/sap/digest/recap/preview implicitly OK (dialog non-empty).

Voice Intro: voice-intro input filled with 'Good morning team, here is your governance briefing.' → digest-save → PUT /api/sap/digest/config 200 → after page reload GET /api/sap/digest/config returns and voice-intro value MATCHES exactly (persisted).

Digest Branding: brand-accent='#7c3aed' updates brand-swatch inline style to rgb(124,58,237); brand-logo URL accepted; digest-save PUT config 200. Invalid accent 'notahex' saved then reloaded → server rejected to empty string ('') as expected (validation working).

Public share page: newly created share (POST /api/sap/digest/share 200) opened at /share/digest/<token> without auth → share-content renders, share-accent-bar has inline style 'height:4px; background: rgb(124,58,237)' matching admin's accent, share-score renders.

AI Thread Titles: New question 'What is the current segregation of duties risk for the Procurement team this week?' → POST /api/sap/digest/ask 200 → History (digest-ask-history-toggle) shows digest-ask-history-0 = 'Procurement SoD Risk Status' — short Title-Case AI-generated title (not the raw long question). Prior manually-renamed threads preserved (e.g. 'Board review 174130').
Open Map: digest-shares list rendered with 2× digest-share-spark-* SVG sparklines and 8× digest-share-opens-* counts (some links have opens, some don't — expected).

network_evidence.recap_preview: dialog populated (endpoint confirmed reachable via UI)
network_evidence.shares_list: GET /api/sap/digest/shares -> 200 (each row now includes series: [14 ints])

critical_code_review_comments: SodCommandCenter.jsx still >1000 lines — consider splitting Voice/Recap/Brand/Ask/Shares blocks into subcomponents for maintainability (non-blocking, previously flagged).
Ask AI DialogContent still lacks aria-describedby (cosmetic Radix a11y warning, previously flagged).
